scope: Three luxury color-adaptive solid balm references, all with explicit official pH-related descriptions. Two new container photographs; Prada U001 shares its existing U000 case card.

entries.descriptionZh: 浅粉色半透明管盖、银色内管与圆头盖顶，让 Lip Glow 很容易辨认。这里收录的是 001 Pink：膏体本身带粉色，官网说明显色会随唇部 pH 调整，妆效偏清透柔亮。
entries.introEn: A sheer pink balm in Dior’s translucent pink case. The brand describes its Color Reviver technology as pH-activated; 001 Pink is the reference shown here.
entries.mechanismZh: Dior 官网：pH-activated color，自适应显色
entries.availabilityZh: 复核时官网页面提供加入购物袋入口；请以品牌实时库存为准。
entries.method: Official Dior US exact C045700001 snapshot reviewed2026-11-13, crawled today: 001 Pink selected, USD42, Size3.2g. Official description explicitly states pH-activated Color Reviver technology. Not the 000 clear shade, oil, mini or refill.
entries.imageAlt: Dior Addict Lip Glow 001 Pink — translucent pink cap, silver tube and pink balm
entries.imageRights: Product photograph credited to the named merchant for editorial identification. Rights remain with the rights holder; no open reuse license was identified.

entries.descriptionZh: 金色方管配透明膏体，膏体中可见金色碎箔。品牌将这款描述为先透明上唇，再依据唇部 pH 显现粉色；它最接近“看着透明、涂后显色”的直观体验。
entries.introEn: A clear balm with gold-toned flecks in a gold square case. Tom Ford describes a sheer veil that develops into a personalized pink stain according to the wearer’s pH.
entries.mechanismZh: Tom Ford 官网：透明涂抹后按 pH 显粉色
entries.availabilityZh: 价格来自品牌官网页面快照；当前库存请向品牌确认。
entries.method: Official US exact product variant52128415416533 snapshot reviewed2026-11-13, reader reported crawled4days earlier: USD64, 3.0g, Z09 Soleil; explicit Works with PH balance and clear-to-pink description. Sephora US sku2573418 cross-check shows same USD64 and3g. Official product JSON request returned429 and was not retried. Clutch-size USD35 and older collection USD62 not used.
entries.imageAlt: Tom Ford Soleil Lip Blush Z09 Soleil — gold square cap and clear balm with gold-toned flecks
entries.imageRights: Product photograph credited to the named merchant for editorial identification. Rights remain with the rights holder; no open reuse license was identified.

entries.formatZh: 固体变色润唇膏 · Standard 正装
entries.descriptionZh: U001 Astral Pink 与已有的 U000 使用相同银色方管，因此合并展示外壳。U001 的重点是玫瑰粉光泽与 pH 自适应显色；不要把 U000 的无色柔雾妆效当成 U001 的效果。
entries.introEn: Astral Pink is Prada Balm’s pH-adaptive rosy version. It shares the silver square case with U000 Universal, so the packaging photograph remains on the existing card.
entries.mechanismZh: Prada 官网：U001 为 pH-activated rosy glow
entries.availabilityZh: 复核页面已选 U001 和 Standard 正装；购买前再确认库存。
entries.method: Exact official US SKU3614274171099 snapshot reviewed2026-11-13; refreshed find result crawled today: U001 ASTRAL PINK and Standard selected, USD50. Description explicitly says pH-activated rosy glow; FAQ restricts adaptive claim to U001/U003. Refill USD40 excluded. Existing U000 photo is linked only to identify shared case, not represented as an image of U001.
